description: Required schedule columns must be populated.
Home and away team cannot be the same.
Team IDs must exist in teams data.
Home and away teams must belong to same division.
Scheduled slot should exist in enabled game dates and venue slots.
A team cannot play two games at same date/time.
A coach cannot have overlapping games.
Warn when division is off its primary venue.
Warn when division uses an avoid-marked slot.
